WESERLINK TELECOM — HOME AIR 5G (fixed wireless) OUTAGE CREDIT PROCEDURE, customer care guideline CG-31, version 2026-08

=====================================================================
PART 1 — RULES
=====================================================================
1.1 Credits are calculated per BILLING PERIOD. A customer's billing period runs from their billing day (inclusive) to the day before the next billing day. Only outage time inside the billing period counts; an outage crossing a boundary counts only for the part inside.
1.2 Identify the radio cell serving the customer's service address using the address-to-cell register (Part 3). Outages are logged per cell (Part 4).
1.3 Cell renaming: during the 2026 network migration, cells were renamed. The legacy network management system (NMS-L) keeps logging the OLD cell name until the site is migrated to NMS-2. Treat old and new names from the rename table (Part 3b) as the same cell.
1.4 Counted outages: only log entries with impact "SERVICE-AFFECTING" count. Entries with impact "DEGRADED" (slower speeds, service still available) do not count.
1.5 Planned maintenance does not count if it was announced to customers at least 48 hours before it started. Planned maintenance announced later than that counts like an unplanned outage.
1.6 Add up all counted outage time for the serving cell in the billing period (hours and minutes), then apply the credit table (Part 2).
1.7 Business plans: for plans classified as BUSINESS in the plan catalogue (Part 5), the credit percentage from Part 2 is doubled (maximum 100 %).
1.8 Credits are applied automatically to the next invoice; agents select the credit label in the CRM.

=====================================================================
PART 2 — CREDIT TABLE (cumulative counted outage time in the billing period)
=====================================================================
| Counted outage time            | Credit (% of monthly plan fee) |
|--------------------------------|--------------------------------|
| less than 12 h                 | 0 %                            |
| 12 h to less than 24 h         | 10 %                           |
| 24 h to less than 48 h         | 25 %                           |
| 48 h to less than 72 h         | 50 %                           |
| 72 h or more                   | 100 % (full month)             |

=====================================================================
PART 6 — AGENT NOTES (reference)
=====================================================================
6.1 Do not promise credits on the phone before running this procedure.
6.2 Goodwill vouchers (max EUR 10) are separate from outage credits and need a team lead.
6.3 Customers who report outages that do not appear in the log: open a network ticket; no credit until the log is updated.
6.4 A customer's own speed tests are not evidence of an outage.
6.5 For outages longer than 72 h, also offer a free mobile data pass (separate process).
6.6 Record in the CRM which log entries were counted and which were excluded, with the reason (outside period, degraded, announced maintenance, other cell).
6.7 If the customer disputes the result, escalate to the Network Credits desk; do not recalculate by hand a second time.
